method.rust: Each physical fn with test/tokio::test/rstest/rstest::rstest/async_std::test attributes, once per workspace Git source path. Inline cfg(test) tests included. Doctests and ordinary helper fn excluded; target reuse and parameter instances not expanded. cfg_gated_functions records direct function attributes, not inherited module gates; all source cfg variants are counted.
method.ignore: Explicit ignore on a test function; Goose subset requires Goose in the ignore reason. Other ignored tests and test-attributed helpers remain visible separately.
method.web: Named it/test callbacks including each, once per physical source declaration. Configuration, hooks and conditional test.skip(condition, reason) excluded. Parameter rows and surrounding loops not expanded.
method.input: Only git ls-tree/git show of resolved commits; neither worktree code nor runtime test results are input. Web parsing uses apps/web/node_modules/typescript (repository pinned compiler), never imports a test.
